messages.subject: For Albert Bourla | Global healthcare, government relations and public-policy execution
messages.body:
Dear Pfizer Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Albert Bourla, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Pfizer's global healthcare platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems and complex public-policy environments. That intersection closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, public-policy stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Pfizer's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Pfizer.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
